subject.why: The round cafe table, two curly white chairs, red-and-white striped awning, and the vase with a single red rose are all clearly depicted and recognisable.

category.why: Follows category 4 with a clear tiled ground strip at the bottom, a bright blue gradient sky, and soft volumetric clouds near the horizon without any clutter.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, watermarks, frames, or characters present.

framing.why: The setup is well-centered with comfortable margins along the top and sides, and cleanly grounded at the bottom.

colour.why: Bright, saturated, and warm palette with excellent contrast against the rich blue sky.

detail.why: Smooth, uncluttered surfaces without noisy micro-details, keeping the focus entirely on the main subject.

style.why: Chunky 3D volumes, soft satin sheen, and clean stylized rendering that closely match the reference cards.
